# Bentley Motors

> > Bentley Motors – British manufacturer of handcrafted luxury performance cars including the Continental GT, Flying Spur, and Bentayga, with a commitment to electrification and carbon-neutral manufacturing through the Beyond100 strategy.

Bentley Motors combines century-old heritage from W.O. Bentley's founding with cutting-edge electrification technology, offering bespoke customization through Mulliner and operating from their historic Crewe factory. The company serves global markets including China with comprehensive dealership networks and sustainable luxury initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Continental GT and GTC
- Flying Spur
- Bentayga SUV
- Beyond100 electrification strategy
- Mulliner bespoke customization
